title: xmlvalidator action
description: Validates an XML body against an XML Schema (XSD 1.0 and 1.1), a DIL resource (xmlvalidator:ref:<name>) or a file. A valid message passes on unchanged. An invalid one carries on with the problems as its body, starting with org.apache.camel.processor.validation.SchemaValidationException, which a router after the step tests for. xs:import and xs:include are not available.

resource.title: Schema
resource.description: The XML Schema: the content of the resource the URI refers to, from dil.core.resources

path.title: Schema file
path.description: Path of a file holding the XML Schema, read when the flow is loaded; set it or the resource
